visible_text: 16. 圖中，扇形 OAB 及扇形 OCD 的圓心均為 O。若 AB̂ = 12π cm、CD̂ = 16π cm 及 OA = 30 cm，則 AC = (A) 5 cm (B) 10 cm (C) 20 cm (D) 40 cm
reasoning: Using the arc length formula s = rθ, the common central angle is θ = (12π)/(30) = 2π/5 rad. For the larger sector, OC satisfies 16π = OC·θ, giving OC = 40 cm. Since OA = 30 cm, AC = OC - OA = 10 cm, which matches option B.
